body:
# Research Summary: Haas Mill Support (NGC Control)

We checked the codebase and public Haas documentation (`haascnc.com` machine specifications and Haas Next Generation Control Mill Operator's Manual).
We used no HSMWorks or Fusion material.

---

## 1. Initial Machine Models and Specifications

The repository currently has zero Haas `.mch` files (`assets/machines/`).
Public `haascnc.com` specification sheets define five starter models:

| Model | X / Y / Z Travel | Spindle Speed and Power | Taper and Rigid Tap | ATC and Tool Limits | Max Feed and Rapids (X/Y/Z) | Nose-to-Table |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **VF-2** | 762 x 406 x 508 mm (30 x 16 x 20 in) | 8,100 rpm standard (15,000 opt), 22.4 kW (30 hp) | CAT40 standard; standard rigid tap | 20 carousel (30+1 opt); 64 mm full / 127 mm empty; 279 mm max length | 16.5 m/min (650 ipm) feed; 25.4 m/min (1000 ipm) rapid | 102 to 610 mm (4 to 24 in) |
| **VF-2SS** | 762 x 406 x 508 mm (30 x 16 x 20 in) | 12,000 rpm standard, 22.4 kW (30 hp) | CAT40 standard; standard rigid tap | 30+1 side-mount; 64 mm full / 127 mm empty; 279 mm max length | 21.2 m/min (833 ipm) feed; 35.6 m/min (1400 ipm) rapid | 102 to 610 mm (4 to 24 in) |
| **Mini Mill** | 406 x 356 x 381 mm (16 x 14 x 15 in) | 8,000 rpm standard (10,000 Super), 7.5 kW (10 hp) | CAT40 (`40 Taper`); synchronized rigid tap | 10 carousel (20 opt); 89 mm full; 305 mm max length | 10.2 m/min (400 ipm) feed and rapid on current base spec (older/EDU/Super variants differ) | 102 to 483 mm (4 to 19 in) |
| **DT-1** | 508 x 406 x 394 mm (20 x 16 x 15.5 in) | 10,000 rpm standard (15,000 opt), 11.2 kW (15 hp) | BT30 standard; rigid tap to 5,000 rpm | 20+1 side-mount; 51 mm full; 254 mm max length | 30.5 m/min (1200 ipm) feed; 61.0 m/min (2400 ipm) rapid | 102 to 610 mm (4 to 24 in) |
| **DM-1** | 508 x 406 x 394 mm (20 x 16 x 15.5 in) | 10,000 rpm standard (15,000 opt), 11.2 kW (15 hp) | CAT40 / BT40; rigid tap to 5,000 rpm | 18+1 side-mount; 64 mm full; 178 mm max length | 30.5 m/min (1200 ipm) feed; 61.0 m/min (2400 ipm) rapid | 152 to 546 mm (6 to 21.5 in) |

Machine onboarding rules (`assets/machines/AGENTS.md` and `docs/MACHINE-ONBOARDING.md`) require strict JSON with no `//` comments.
Linear travels use `-L..L` in program coordinates, and Z `safe_retract` uses `0.0` at machine home.
CamCraft already defines `CAT40` and `BT30` mounts (`crates/post/src/machine/tooling.rs:35`) and matching holders (`CAT40 ER32`, `BT30 ER16`..`ER32` in `crates/tools/src/holder_library.rs:323-341`).

---

## 2. Haas NGC Control Conventions

Public Haas NGC documentation defines these behaviors:

- **Smoothing (`G187`):** `G187 Pn Ennnn` sets acceleration smoothness and corner-rounding tolerance in active units (`G20` or `G21`). `P1` selects Rough, `P2` selects Medium, and `P3` selects Finish (`Setting 191` sets the power-on default `P2`). NGC software `100.26.001.1200+` also supports `P11`–`P20` (`P14` matches `P2`, `P17` matches `P3`). `Ennnn` overrides `Setting 85`, and bare `G187` cancels `E` and restores `Setting 191`.
- **Work offsets (`G54`–`G59` and `G154 P1`–`P99`):** Standard offsets `G54`–`G59` use `G10 L2 P1..P6` and macro variables `#5221+`. Extended offsets `G154 P1`–`P99` use `G10 L20 P1..P99` and macro variables `#14001+` (20 variables per offset; `P1`–`P20` also map to `G110`–`G129` and `#7001+`).
- **Program start, tool change, tool length, and end:** NGC files wrap in `%` with a 5-digit `O00001`–`O99999` program number. Side-mount ATC machines (`VF-2SS`, `DT-1`, `DM-1`) can pre-stage the next tool with `T<next>` before `M06`. `M06` automatically stops coolant, stops the spindle, and retracts Z to home. `G43 Hnn` applies length offset `nn`, and `Setting 15` checks that `H` matches `T`. NGC manuals recommend `G53 G00 Z0` (with optional `G49`) and `G53 Y0` at program end instead of `G91 G28`, followed by `M30` and `%`.
- **Dwell (`P`) and canned cycles:** In `G04`, `G82`, `G83`, and `G73`, an integer `P` without a decimal specifies milliseconds, while a decimal `P` specifies seconds. `G73` and `G83` support constant `Q` or variable `I/J/K` peck depths (`Setting 22` sets `G73` chip-break retract). `G84` performs right-hand rigid tapping with `J1`–`J9` retract multiplier (`Setting 130` sets the default). `G74` performs left-hand rigid tapping.
- **M-codes:** `M08`/`M09` control flood coolant, while `M88`/`M89` control Through-Spindle Coolant (`M89` cancels `M88` and purges). `M73`/`M74` control Tool Air Blast, `M83`/`M84` control Auto Air Gun / air jet, and `M31`/`M33` start and stop the chip auger.
- **Probing:** `G31` records skip positions in `#5061`–`#5063`, alarms via `#3000`, and pauses via `#3006`. NGC software builds in Custom Macro B and `G31`; Renishaw WIPS adds protected `O9000` cycles.

---

## 3. Gaps in `assets/posts/haas.cps` and CamCraft Today

1. **No Haas `.mch` definitions:** `assets/machines/` and `crates/app/src/posting.rs` (`MACHINES`) include no Haas machines.
2. **Program end leaves `G91` modal:** `onClose()` (`assets/posts/haas.cps`) and golden outputs (`crates/app/tests/golden/nc/haas/*.nc`) end with `G91 G28 Z0`, `G28 X0 Y0`, `M30`. `haas.cps` does not restore `G90` before `M30` and ignores `safe_retract` (`G53 G0 Z0` / `G53 Y0`).
3. **Missing `G94` and tool pre-staging:** `startPreamble()` emits `G17 G90 <wcsWord> G40 G49 G80` without `G94`. `onToolChange()` does not support `T<next>` pre-staging on side-mount ATCs.
4. **Missing `millSpindleReverse` and `G74`:** `haas.cps` omits `millSpindleReverse = true;` (`crates/post/src/post/engine.rs:229-235` refuses `M04` milling ops) and hardcodes `M3`. `onCycle()` (`assets/posts/haas.cps:585-625`) maps all `TAP` ops to `G84` with no `G74` left-hand option and no `J` retract multiplier.
5. **Missing `explains = "paren";`:** `crates/post/src/post/explain.rs:1-20` refuses `postOptions.Explain = true` on `haas.cps` because the manifest omits `explains`.
6. **Coolant-off and chip auger gaps:** `haas.cps` ends every coolant mode with `M9` alone instead of emitting `M89` for `M88` (TSC) or `M74`/`M84` for air blast (`M73`/`M83`). `M31`/`M33` chip auger control is absent.
7. **`G187` and `G73`/`G83` limits:** `smoothOn()` supports `P1` and `P3` only (`P2` and `P11`–`P20` absent). `onCycle()` emits `Q` pecks only and omits `I/J/K`.
8. **No `G154 P1`–`P99` support:** `crates/app/src/operation/types/sel.rs:6` restricts `WCS_SLOTS` to `["G54", "G55", "G56", "G57", "G58", "G59"]`. `haas.cps` (`slotOf()` and `onProbeResult()`, lines `627-731`) only maps `G54`–`G59` to `#5221+` and `G10 L2`, defaulting anything else to `G54`.

---

## 4. 4th and 5th Axis Requirements

- **4th-axis rotary tables (`HRT160`, `HRT210`):** Standard platters are 160 mm (127.00 mm center height, 130 deg/s) and 210 mm (152.40 mm center height, 100 deg/s), with continuous 360-degree travel and pneumatic brakes (`M10` clamp, `M11` unclamp). `haas.cps` (`tiltOk()`) refuses every tilted move today. CamCraft's `judge.rs:157` (`x_rotary_problem`) and `tormach.cps` (`aRotary`) already support indexed `A` rotation about X.
- **5th-axis trunnions and UMCs (`TR160`, `TR210`, `TRT100`, `UMC-500`):** `TR`/`TRT` add-on trunnions expose `A` tilt (`±120°`, `TR160` center height `175.26 mm` on `TRT160`) plus rotary `B` (`360°`). `UMC-500` exposes `B` tilt (`+120°` to `-35°`) plus `C` rotation (`360°`). Brakes use `M10`/`M11` (4th axis) and `M12`/`M13` (5th axis), kept released during simultaneous cuts.
- **NGC options and code requirements:** Haas NGC uses **`G254`**/`G255` (DWO) for 3+2 indexing and **`G234`** (TCPC) for simultaneous 4/5-axis motion (not Fanuc `G43.4`). Both `G254` and `G234` are paid factory options; machines without them need `G93` inverse-time feed for rotary cuts.
- **CamCraft blocker for 5-axis:** `crates/cl/src/cl/pose.rs:53` (`axis_to_angles`) outputs `[A, B, 0.0]`, and `crates/app/src/machine/judge.rs:79-105` checks literal axis letters without inverse kinematics. That rejects a `B+C` UMC on any Y tilt and misreads `TR160` platter `B` as static Y rotation. Multi-axis Haas work needs IK/kinematic design before `haas.cps` emits 5-axis code.

---

## Design Proposal (Smallest Useful Slice First)

1. **Slice 1 — 3-axis Haas machine files + `haas.cps` NGC safety fixes:**
   Ship five verified 3-axis `.mch` files (`VF-2`, `VF-2SS`, `Mini Mill`, `DT-1`, `DM-1`) and fix `haas.cps` safety/NGC baseline (`G90`/home handling, `G94`, `M89`/`M74`/`M84` off codes, `M4`/`millSpindleReverse`, `G74`, `explains = "paren"`).
2. **Slice 2 — Productivity features and `G154 P1`–`P99`:**
   Add `G187 P2`/`P11`–`P20`, `G84 J`, `G73`/`G83 I/J/K`, `M31`/`M33` auger, and `T<next>` pre-staging, plus app-wide `G154 P1`–`P99` work offsets and probing (`G10 L20`, `#14001+`).
3. **Slice 3 — Haas NGC air-cut tester kit:**
   Follow `docs/tester-kits/tormach-microarc-4th/` to let Haas owners validate real controller behavior safely above the part.
4. **Slice 4 — 4th-axis indexing, then 5-axis research/kinematics:**
   Ship 4th-axis `HRT160`/`HRT210` indexing (`M10`/`M11` and optional `G254`/`G255`), and run dedicated design research on 5-axis kinematics (`A+B` and `B+C`), `G234`, and `G93`.

---

## Concrete Sub-Issues

1. **Haas: add 3-axis `.mch` files for VF-2, VF-2SS, Mini Mill, DT-1, and DM-1** — Adds five validated Haas `.mch` machine files and registers them in `posting::MACHINES`.
   - Done means: All five files parse, validate, appear in the machine picker, and pass limit tests in `crates/app/tests/haas_machines.rs`.
   - Priority: `P6` | Effort: `effort:medium` | Area: `area:post`
2. **Haas: fix NGC startup, retract, spindle, explain, and coolant-off handling in `haas.cps`** — Updates `haas.cps` for `G90`/`G53` safety, `G94`, `millSpindleReverse`/`G74`, `explains = "paren"`, and `M89`/`M74`/`M84` off codes.
   - Done means: `haas.cps` posts NGC-safe start/end blocks without leaving `G91` active at `M30` and passes tests for `M89`, air blast off, `M4`, `G74`, and `Explain`.
   - Priority: `P6` | Effort: `effort:high` | Area: `area:post`
3. **Haas: add NGC G187 P2, variable peck, tap J retract, auger, and tool pre-staging** — Adds opt-in NGC `G187 P2`/`P11`–`P20`, `G73`/`G83 I/J/K`, `G84 J`, `M31`/`M33` auger, and `T<next>` pre-staging to `haas.cps`.
   - Done means: Option-gated tests verify each feature when enabled while default golden programs stay unchanged.
   - Priority: `P7` | Effort: `effort:high` | Area: `area:post`
4. **Haas: add extended work offsets (`G154 P1`–`P99`) in setup WCS and `haas.cps`** — Extends CamCraft WCS selection beyond `G54`–`G59` and adds `G154 Pn`, `G10 L20 Pn`, and `#14001+` probing math.
   - Done means: Setups support `G154 P1`–`P99` on Haas posts and `haas.cps` emits valid `G154` offsets and probing writes.
   - Priority: `P6` | Effort: `effort:high` | Area: `area:post`
5. **Haas: add NGC 3-axis air-cut tester kit** — Adds a hardware air-cut `.camproj`, safety guide, golden `.nc`, and test following the MicroArc tester kit layout.
   - Done means: `docs/tester-kits/haas-ngc-3axis/` and a test in `crates/app/tests/` verify clean air-cut `.nc` generation.
   - Priority: `P7` | Effort: `effort:medium` | Area: `area:post`
6. **Haas: add 4th-axis HRT160/HRT210 indexing and `.mch` variants** — Adds `HRT160`/`HRT210` `.mch` definitions and `A`-axis indexing (`M10`/`M11` clamp and optional `G254`/`G255` DWO) in `haas.cps`.
   - Done means: An indexed 4th-axis setup passes `machine::check` and posts `M11`/`G0 A..`/`M10` while refusing simultaneous tilt.
   - Priority: `P8` | Effort: `effort:high` | Area: `area:post`
7. **Research: Haas 5-axis trunnions (`TR160`/`UMC-500`), `G254` DWO, `G234` TCPC, and `G93`** — Designs inverse kinematics (`A+B` and `B+C`), brake control (`M10`–`M13`), and option-gated `G254`/`G234`/`G93` output.
   - Done means: A design decision in `docs/decisions/` specifies kinematic checking in `cl`/`judge.rs` and G-code emission rules for `haas.cps`.
   - Priority: `P8` | Effort: `effort:max` | Area: `area:post`

Filed seven sub-issues from this research:

- #1976 (`P6`, `effort:medium`, `area:post`) — Haas: add 3-axis .mch files for VF-2, VF-2SS, Mini Mill, DT-1, and DM-1
- #1977 (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`) — Haas: fix NGC startup, retract, spindle, explain, and coolant-off handling in haas.cps
- #1978 (`P7`, `effort:high`, `area:post`) — Haas: add NGC G187 P2, variable peck, tap J retract, auger, and tool pre-staging
- #1979 (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`) — Haas: add extended work offsets (G154 P1-P99) in setup WCS and haas.cps
- #1981 (`P7`, `effort:medium`, `area:post`) — Haas: add NGC 3-axis air-cut tester kit
- #1984 (`P8`, `effort:high`, `area:post`) — Haas: add 4th-axis HRT160/HRT210 indexing and .mch variants
- #1986 (`P8`, `effort:max`, `area:post`) — Research: Haas 5-axis trunnions (TR160/UMC-500), G254 DWO, G234 TCPC, and G93

This umbrella issue stays open with `needs-research` for maintainer review.
